To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of a hybrid recommenders system based on content-based and serendipity heuristics is a viable solution for the over-specialization issue; (2) the use of serendipitous suggestions is not a viable solution for all the users and all the contexts, and (3) the use of hybrid recommender systems based on content-based approach and heuristics for serendipity is a solution for the over- specialization issue in the context of e-commerce
the proposed hybrid approach is able to mitigate the over specialisation problem of content-based recommenders, by suggesting serendipitous recommendations.
the serendipity can be implemented as an heuristic in the content-based recommendation system.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design of a system that, in a context of content-based recommender systems, can provide suggestions that are not only based on the similarity between the user and the items, but that can also take into consideration some heuristics that can stimulate the users to explore the space of items and find some serendipitous ones.
the design of a recommender system that can be used for both, the recommendation of similar items, and the recommendation of serendipitous items.
the design and implementation issues of a content-based recommender system that takes into account a serendipity heuristic in order to mitigate over-specialization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybrid approach is able to improve the performance of the system, in terms of both serendipity and accuracy, compared to the content-based one.
our approach has the potential to provide a better user experience in the context of serendipitous recommendations.

our system is a content-based recommender system with a serendipity module that is able to recommend items that the user is likely to be interested in and, in addition, to suggest items that are not similar but still useful to the user.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed a recommender system that is based on the content-based approach, but that it is also capable of providing serendipitous recommendations.
our hybrid recommender system, which we called “Serenade”, has a content-based module and a serendipity-based module, which are integrated to provide a more effective recommendation system.
our recommender system is able to provide recommendations based on user preferences and also based on serendipitous criteria.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to combine serendipity and content-based recommendation, thus allowing the system to recommend items that are similar and dissimilar to the user's past choices.
serendipitous suggestions can be used to increase the diversity of recommendations without compromising the quality of the system.
the use of serendipity can be a powerful tool to stimulate users to explore new items, even in content-based recommenders.
